title: StockSmart Storeroom Desk Reference — Conversion Entry for a Bin Leaving Consignment
content:
**StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program.** When a slow-moving consigned item has been withdrawn from its bin at a par review, Corbett records the bin's conversion entry under the StockSmart conversion reorder point schedule: a par level entry that shows the bin no longer consigned, keeps its item, its flags and its fill-to level, and sets its customer-owned reorder point.

Corbett's conversion entry for such a bin is recorded only after the bin's entries of their latest date include the customer's written request, a par level entry that names no reorder point and sets the customer-owned fill-to level.

In the terms of the bin history: until the bin's entries of their latest date include such a request entry of the customer, with no reorder point and with the customer-owned fill-to level, the conversion entry is not recorded.

### Recording the entry: `record_customer_owned_conversion_b1c25ecb`

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call books a single par level entry, effective today, that shows the bin as no longer consigned: it keeps the item, the special-stock and critical flags and the fill-to level passed in, and takes the customer-owned reorder point passed in. Corbett's entries carry a reference of the form VBR-NNNNNN.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `vmi_program_id` | the reference number of the StockSmart program that holds the bin, read from the StockSmart program lookup | identifier |
| `bin_label` | the bin label exactly as it appears on the bin's latest entry in the bin history | text, copied character for character |
| `sku` | the Corbett item number exactly as it appears on the bin's latest entry | text, copied character for character |
| `special_stock` | whether the bin's latest entry flags the item as non-catalog special stock | `true` or `false` |
| `critical_item` | whether the bin's latest entry flags the bin critical | `true` or `false` |
| `max_qty` | the bin's fill-to level as it stands on its latest entry | whole number of units |
| `min_qty` | the customer-owned reorder point being recorded | whole number of units, 0 or more |

### Receipt

On success: `status` "recorded", `vmi_bin_id` (reference number of the conversion entry), `change_reference` (format VBR-NNNNNN), `bin_label`, `sku`, `consigned` (always false), `min_qty` and `max_qty` (whole units) and `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD). The tool defines no other outcome.

### What the entry shows

From the conversion entry on, the bin's entries show it no longer consigned: customer-owned, with its item, flags and fill-to level carried over and its new customer-owned reorder point.
